deep.reconstruction:
This page continues a section on eigenvalues of compact operators on a complex Hilbert space E, handled through their exterior powers Λ̄^n E (Hilbert exterior powers) and Λ̄^n u. It belongs to the preparatory material for Grothendieck's Fredholm theory and his work on eigenvalue distribution for operators in Banach spaces.

The previous page proves the key spectral fact (Prop. 3). Split E orthogonally as E_0 ⊕ E_1, with E_0 the finite-dimensional sum of root spaces for nonzero eigenvalues and u(E_1) small or zero. Then Λ̄^n E decomposes as the sum over p+q=n of Λ^p E_0 ⊗ Λ^q E_1. From this, the nonzero eigenvalues of Λ̄^n u (with multiplicity) are exactly the products λ_{i1}…λ_{in} with distinct indices i1<…<in. The top of this page finishes that argument, reduces it to compact operators, and states the consequence. When the eigenvalues are ordered by decreasing modulus, λ_1(Λ̄^n u) = λ_1(u)…λ_n(u). This is the margin formula (21).

Corollary 2. Let u be a compact operator on a complex Hilbert space E. Let λ_i be its eigenvalues (decreasing modulus, with multiplicity) and ρ_i the eigenvalues of (u*u)^{1/2} (singular numbers). Then for every n:
(23) |λ_1…λ_n| ≤ ρ_1…ρ_n.
Proof: |λ_1(Λ̄^n u)| ≤ spectral radius ≤ ‖Λ̄^n u‖. Also ‖Λ̄^n u‖ = ‖((Λ̄^n u)*(Λ̄^n u))^{1/2}‖ = ‖Λ̄^n((u*u)^{1/2})‖. Since Λ̄^n is multiplicative and commutes with adjoints, this equals the largest eigenvalue of Λ̄^n|u|, namely ρ_1…ρ_n. That is formula (22). A struck-out attempt computes ‖Λ̄^n u‖ directly.

Corollary 3 is begun at the bottom and finished on the next page. For E, F, G Hilbert spaces and compact maps u, w, it states ρ_1(uw)…ρ_m(uw) ≤ ∏ρ_i(u)ρ_i(w) (24). The proof is the same: ‖Λ̄^m(uw)‖ = ‖Λ̄^m u Λ̄^m w‖ ≤ ‖Λ̄^m u‖‖Λ̄^m w‖.

The next page credits the idea of (23), (24) to H. Weyl, together with their use for the convexity inequalities of the following section. These are inequalities of the type Σ f(|λ_i|) ≤ Σ f(ρ_i) for suitable convex f, giving for instance Σ|λ_i|^p ≤ Σρ_i^p.
errors: No mathematical error is visible. The proof of Corollary 2 is the standard exterior-power proof of Weyl's inequality and is correct, given multiplicativity of Λ̄^n and (Λ̄^n u)* = Λ̄^n(u*). Several struck-out passages show attempts to compute ‖Λ̄^n u‖ that were abandoned in favour of the clean formula (22).

ideas.what: Eigenvalues of Λ̄^n u are products of n eigenvalues of u with distinct indices, for compact u on a Hilbert space (via the root-space decomposition E_0 ⊕ E_1)
ideas.modern_name: Spectrum of exterior powers of a compact operator
ideas.usually_credited_to: H. Weyl (1949), classical in finite dimension
ideas.where_published: Probably used in 'La théorie de Fredholm' (Bull. SMF 1956) and in Produits tensoriels topologiques (1955); unsure of the exact statement
Likely cited or used in Grothendieck's Fredholm/PTT eigenvalue estimates, credited there to Weyl

ideas.modern_name: Horn's inequality for singular values of products

deep.surprise_reason: This is a clean but standard rederivation of Weyl's (1949) and Horn's (1950) inequalities by exterior powers. Grothendieck himself attributes the idea to Weyl on the next page. It is preparatory material for his known eigenvalue results for nuclear and p-summing operators. Nothing new or uncredited appears.
transcription_corrections: The red-boxed formula (23) reads |λ_1 … λ_n| ≤ ρ_1 … ρ_n, not '|λ_i - λ_n| ≤ ...'.
Margin formula (21): λ_1(u)…λ_n(u) = λ_1(Λ̄^n u), not 'λ_i(u) - λ_n(Λ̄u) = λ_i(Λ̄u)'.
The line after the box reads roughly '|λ_1(Λ̄^n u)| ≤ ‖Λ̄^n u‖ … d'après (21) et (22)'. The 'Λ̄' throughout should carry the superscript n.
Corollaire 2: 'Soit u un op. compact dans un espace de Hilbert complexe E'.
Bottom line: 'Corollaire 3. Soient E, F, G trois espaces de Hilbert'.
